title: ISO 9660 CD-ROM image signature (CD001)
summary: An ISO 9660 filesystem image carries the primary volume descriptor at sector 16 (offset 32768), whose 5-byte identifier is 'CD001' at offset 1 within the descriptor.
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Sector 17+ hold supplementary/boot descriptors; last descriptor is type 0xFF.
